environment.description: Same Rails application deployed in Kubernetes pod with SecurityContext specifying 'drop: [ALL]' and adding back only CAP_CHOWN, CAP_SETUID, CAP_SETGID, CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE, CAP_FOWNER, CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Notably CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN are NOT granted. Pod runs with seccompProfile type RuntimeDefault. The node uses containerd 1.7 with default AppArmor profile (docker-default equivalent). ReadOnlyRootFilesystem is set to true with explicit writable emptyDir volume mounted at /app/public/uploads (noexec mount option via PodSecurityPolicy admission). The container image uses distroless Ruby base (gcr.io/distroless/ruby30-debian11) which lacks shell binaries, ImageMagick, tar, unzip, and other system utilities.

config.network_policy: egress denied except DNS and internal services on port 5432
